title: SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.32917v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep search agents address complex information needs through iterative retrieval and reasoning, where the relevance of retrieved evidence influences downstream performance. Existing rerankers improve retrieval effectiveness but introduce substantial latency and cost when invoked throughout the search trajectory. We introduce SOARS, a training-free framework leveraging a System One model for fast, calibrated relevance estimation. At each search step, SOARS selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency, and inference cost. translated_title: SOARS：面向智能体搜索的系统一（System One）辅助重排序
translated_abstract: 深度搜索智能体通过迭代检索与推理来满足复杂的信息需求，其中检索到的证据的相关性会直接影响下游任务的性能。现有的重排序器虽然能够提升检索效果，但在整个搜索过程中被频繁调用时会引入大量的延迟和成本。我们提出了SOARS，这是一个无需训练的框架，利用“系统一”模型进行快速且经过校准的相关性估计。在每个搜索步骤中，SOARS从长文档中筛选出与查询相关的段落，并在单次调用中完成候选结果的重排序，同时综合考虑原始问题和智能体生成的子查询。在BrowseComp-Plus和WebShaper数据集上的六个大语言模型骨干上，SOARS持续提升答案准确率和证据召回率，同时减少搜索调用次数、端到端延迟和推理成本。在BrowseComp-Plus上，它将GPT-5.4 Mini的准确率从73.9%提升至84.7%，同时将搜索调用次数从23次降至14次，……
tldr: SOARS是一个无需训练的智能体搜索重排序框架，利用快速“系统一”模型在单次调用中完成相关性估计与候选重排序，在六个大模型骨干上显著提升答案准确率和证据召回率，同时大幅降低搜索调用次数、延迟和推理成本。
en_tdlr: SOARS is a training-free reranking framework for agentic search that leverages a fast "System One" model for calibrated relevance estimation and single-call reranking, consistently improving answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, latency, and inference cost across six LLM backbones.
